task_description: Add Content Security Policy (CSP) header to prevent XSS attacks

patterns.security_headers: Security headers are defined in next.config.ts via async headers() function
patterns.header_structure: Headers apply to all routes with pattern '/(.*)', returned as array of objects with source and headers fields
patterns.dangerouslySetInnerHTML_usage: Used in tables/page.tsx:192 and dashboard-client.tsx:442 for QR code SVG rendering from trusted qrcode library

existing_implementations.description: next.config.ts already has security headers defined. Need to add CSP header to the existing headers array while preserving current headers.

security_considerations.xss_risk: dangerouslySetInnerHTML creates potential XSS vectors if SVG content is compromised
csp_requirements: Allow data: URIs for images (QR codes may use this)
security_considerations.defense_in_depth: CSP provides additional security layer even when SVG is from trusted source
